company.value: Retool is a San Francisco-based enterprise AppGen/developer platform that, by its own description, supports building production-ready internal apps, agents, and automations connected to business data with governed deployment controls. Built In lists 350 employees, which Retool does not independently confirm on the official pages reviewed.

funding.value: The most recent publicly announced financing located was a $45,000,000 Series C2 at a $3,200,000,000 valuation; Retool and TechCrunch identify the announcement as a Series C2, and TechCrunch published its coverage on 2022-07-28T13:03:00Z.

hiring_signals.value: Retool’s direct careers-page snapshot listed 32 open roles across functions including Engineering, Product, Data Science & Analytics, Sales, Sales Development, Success, and Support.

An open Staff Product Manager, Automation role says the hire will scale automation across workflows, integrations, and AI-driven agents, and characterizes automation as a core product-strategy pillar.
An open Software Engineer, Governance role covers policies, access controls, audit trails, security infrastructure, agent permissioning/observability, and security administration capabilities.

An open Business Development Representative role says Retool grew its sales team 3x in the prior year and needs to continue expanding to meet 2026 revenue targets; the role includes prospecting, testing outbound strategies, booking qualified meetings, and Salesforce pipeline analysis.
The concurrent automation, governance, and GTM openings suggest Retool is investing in enterprise-ready AI/workflow capabilities while continuing structured outbound growth.

likely_use_case.value: A plausible use case is an SDR research-and-qualification workflow that combines company-data research, AI-assisted account summaries, routing, and CRM workflow steps. This is an inference from Retool’s stated app/agent/automation positioning and its active automation and outbound-sales hiring, not evidence of an existing Retool deployment for this use case.

deal_band.value: Likely mid-market to enterprise opportunity, based on Retool’s externally listed 350 employees, multi-office footprint, enterprise positioning, and active sales-development expansion. Budget, buying process, and the SDR organization’s tooling are not verified.

unverified: Any financing announced after the publicly located Series C2 announcement covered by TechCrunch on 2022-07-28T13:03:00Z.
Publication dates for the current job listings.
Whether Retool currently uses a dedicated SDR research-automation product or has an active project/budget for one.
